sources.title: GitHub - almustafa-ai/hausa-ai-analysis: Research notes on where ...
sources.snippet: Why it happens: Training data for Hausa skews heavily toward religious texts (particularly Quranic translations and Islamic literature) and news media. This creates a model that has limited exposure to the full spectrum of Hausa registers — the formal administrative language, the oral storytelling tradition, the intimate family register, the marketplace language.

sources.title: Tushe — Foundation of Hausa Intelligence
sources.snippet: Tushe: Where Data Becomes Understanding Tushe is a community-driven data foundry dedicated to building, refining, and democratizing Hausa language datasets — from speech to text, translation, and beyond. We aim to create the foundation for Hausa AI models that understand, speak, and think like us.

sources.title: HausaNLP (HausaNLP) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We are a community dedicated to advancing Natural Language Processing (NLP) for Hausa, a widely spoken language in West Africa. We aim to create and provide high-quality resources and models to facilitate Hausa language understanding and generation in the AI community.
